functions.name: browser_control
functions.title: Control CloudBrowser
functions.description: Drive the CloudBrowser headless browser runtime — create sessions, navigate, observe semantic elements, click/type/fill, extract structured data, screenshot, run bounded agent steps, request approvals, and manage jobs. Pass 'tool' to select the action and 'params' for its arguments. Most tools require a session_id (returned by browser_start). Available tools: browser_start, browser_end, browser_status, browser_health, navigate, reload, back, forward, observe, find_element, inspect_dom, inspect_accessibility_tree, click, hover, type, fill, press_key, scroll, select_option, wait_for, wait_for_selector, wait_for_navigation, wait_for_network_idle, extract_text, extract_links, extract_structured, screenshot, full_page_screenshot, list_tabs, open_tab, close_tab, switch_tab, get_console, get_network, get_errors, download_file, session_save, session_restore, context_create, context_save, context_restore, context_attach, context_delete, run_script, compare_screenshots, agent_execute, agent_pause, agent_resume, agent_cancel, approval_request, approval_status, job_create, job_run, job_pause, job_resume, job_cancel, job_retry, receipt_get, evidence_get. Call browser_start first to get a session_id, then navigate + observe to see the page.

tool.description: The browser control tool to invoke (e.g. browser_start, navigate, observe, click, extract_structured, screenshot, agent_execute, approval_request).

params.description: Arguments for the tool. browser_start: {viewport}. navigate: {session_id, url}. observe: {session_id}. click/type/fill: {session_id, selector, value}. extract_structured: {session_id, schema, prompt}. screenshot: {session_id}. session_restore: {state_token, optional session_id}. context_attach: {context_id}. compare_screenshots: {session_id, reference_url}. agent_execute: {session_id, goal}. approval_request: {action_type, target, reason}. Most tools need session_id.

functions.name: copilot_chat
functions.title: Chat through CloudBrowser Copilot
functions.description: Send messages to the CloudBrowser Copilot panel and receive AI responses powered by ChatGPT (GPT-5). Use action='send' with a message string to chat, action='receive' to read recent messages, or action='history' to get the full conversation. The Copilot panel displays these messages in real time. Responses are generated using GPT-5 with the full CloudBrowser system context.

action.description: The relay action: 'send' (send a message and get a GPT-5 response), 'receive' (read recent messages), or 'history' (full conversation)

message.description: The message text to send (required for 'send' action)

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation ID for grouping messages (defaults to 'mcp_default')
